_annotation.what: Digital product catalog — downloadable tools, templates, and resources with price, description, and duration (0 for instant-download items).

_annotation.ai_popolates: Product names and descriptions: Generated from your stated offerings. Prices: AI validates against market rates. Bundle recommendations: AI suggests package deals (e.g., 'Kit + Course Premium').
_annotation.your_input: List your digital products with price and description. We format them into the catalog structure and suggest bundles.
